answer_1.quote: In this paper, we explore an alternative: characters and subwords as form-based and more fine-grained representations of both the input and output of the question generation task.
datasets: German QA answer corpus created by De Kuthy et al.

answer_2.quote: We used the standard Sacre-BLEU library

answer_4.quote: The quality of the generated questions was manually evaluated by two human annotators, both trained linguists and native speakers of German.
answer_4.guideline: They were asked to provide a binary judgment: whether the question is well-formed and satisfies question-answer congruence with the source sentence.
